itemList.description: OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE OF MULTI VILLAGE WATER SUPPLY SCHEME TO MVS KARADIGUDDA AND OTHER 13 VILLAGES OF DHARWAD TALUKA DHARWAD DISTRICT for the year of2026-27:Establishment: Providing Sufficient techical staff, Electrician, Pump Operators, valve man, helpers, watchmen and other who are required to run the system in complete manner. The said staff shall be made avilable round the clock for mainainance of pure water sump. This consists of all kinds of repaire to damged structures cleaning, washing and painting for civil structures once in a year. Repairs and replacement of damaged pipe line, valves etc. It found necessary including cost of materials and charges and also monitoring the system. This mainteinance involves pure water rising main, gravity mains and maintaining the discharge the quantum of water in all mains. III. Operation and Maintenance of pumping machineries : Operation and Maintenance of pumping machineries established in jack well at intermidiate sump, water treatment plant and in other sumps with due care by pupm operators duly lubricating, greasing with all required care and should run the pumps satisfactorily including electrical maintenance covring all repairs, replacement of electrical cabel, swich board, replacement of burnt parts of machinery. All the above repairs and maintenance shall be carried out as per the direction of Engineer in charge for satisfactory functioning of the scheme to provide designed discharge for drinking water to all the habitations of the scheme. IV. Operatiom and maintenance of water treatment plants (WTP) : O&M of WTP includes dosing of required quantity of alum, clorine and other required necessary chemicals at prescribed stage to treat the raw water including replacement of sand/ filter media as required as per the standards of established norms from time to time. Maintaining the quality of water as per guidelines, Transportation and Communication charge : Transportation charges include cost of mobilization of staff for satisfactory functioning of all components of scheme. Providing uniform to staff precautionary accessories such as wellington shoes, torch, helmet, hand gloves etc. required to discharge their duties satisfactory. The communication charge includes cost of comminication to the staff through mobile phones for conversation amongst the staff spared over the project. The contractor should maintain a log book on the working of all components including day today records of units consumed per day The payment will be made by the Engineer in charges for satisfactory report of every month end (the GP Secretary and SO in charge of WSS Should give satisfactory report) subject to condition appended in TOR. For the 1st year- with all lead and lift the work should be carried out as per the instructions of Engineer in charge of the work.
